title: Community Connect Strengthens Santa Monica Emergency Response
description:
🚒 Help us help you when seconds count
Community Connect is a vital tool that gives Santa Monica’s first responders the critical information they need to make quick, informed decisions during an emergency.
Here’s how to get started:
1️⃣ Create an account
Sign in for free with your email, phone number and address.
2️⃣ Enter the info that matters most
Add details that help firefighters assist you more effectively in an emergency.
3️⃣ Help your Fire Department when seconds count
Keep your information updated so we’re always ready to respond.
Having details like floor plans, pets or specific medical needs can make all the difference when every second matters.
Learn more and sign up at communityconnect.io/info/ca-santamonica
